jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the CORE BODY turnaround edit target. Image 2 is the authoritative HEAD turnaround sheet. Fix ONLY THE HEAD in Image 1's RIGHTMOST REAR full-body figure. Leave all other pixels/designs/poses/body armor and the other two figures unchanged.
The rear core head currently omits the central GOLD horn, showing just four side gold fins and the red fin. Correct it to the same FIVE-GOLD crown topology as Image 2's top-right rear head: two long inner gold fins, two short outer gold fins, and ONE GOLD CENTRAL HORN visible ABOVE/BEHIND the shorter narrow RED dorsal-fin edge. The red thin center edge cannot replace the taller gold center horn. Match center gold tip height to front view's tip height. Copy the rear navy faceted shell and central panel seam from the correct rear head in Image 2; remove the spurious big gold block under the red fin on the back of head if inconsistent. Keep both gold ear housings, neck attachment, head size, shoulder positions and guide lines unchanged. Do NOT draw a face on the rear. Do NOT change torso backpack sockets, rear skirt, arms or legs. No extra gold or red horns. Preserve the light background and original full three-view composition.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: KING FULL EQUIPMENT complete three-view design sheet. Very wide landscape about 3:1, clean light warm-white background.
Input 1 = APPROVED full-equipped King's body/equipment identity. Input 2 = the matching CORE turnaround, proportion/pose reference BELOW the neck ONLY; its rear crown is not authority. Input 3 = APPROVED battle-mask head with crimson dorsal fin. Input 4 = head turnaround authority for helmet front/side/rear.
Make exactly THREE complete full-body orthographic-style views of the SAME fully equipped King: FRONT, LEFT PROFILE facing screen-left, REAR. Allocate wider space to front and rear wing spans, narrower middle profile. Same body scale and common floor line across all three. Use the same underlying skull/shoulder/hip/knee/ankle heights and proportions as core Input 2. Standing upright, legs shoulder-width, upper arms slightly away from torso, both elbows bent about 20 degrees so forearms angle slightly FORWARD/DOWN. Same physical pose across views. Complete horn tips, wings, drill tip, shield tip and both boots visible; no overlaps between columns and no cropping. No 3/4, no perspective, no action pose.
Retain heavy navy/ivory/crimson/gold King, paired gold CHEST louvres and central champion emblem, layered shoulders, existing waist/leg armor and broad gold-toed navy boots. Those chest front features do NOT appear on the back. Head is the approved BATTLE MASK state with ONE thin crimson sagittal dorsal fin, FIVE gold crown members including central upward-curving horn and four paired side fins. FRONT red fin hidden behind taller gold middle horn; PROFILE shows broad crimson triangle; REAR shows a thin red center edge AND the taller gold central horn beyond it. Don't omit the center gold horn, flatten the head or remove the mask.
EXACT equipment inventory and handedness:
- ONE big gold helical drill over the robot's ANATOMICAL RIGHT forearm, aimed down and slightly forward. FRONT = drill screen-LEFT. REAR = same drill screen-RIGHT. LEFT PROFILE = it belongs to the FAR arm, partly occluded by body/near shield; any visible tip still points down/forward toward screen-left. Never duplicate drills or change arms.
- ONE long ivory/navy/gold champion shield on ANATOMICAL LEFT forearm. FRONT = screen-RIGHT with the existing red lozenge and gold crest on OUTER face. REAR = screen-LEFT, show NAVY INNER surface with dark mounting brackets/straps and gold coupling, NO gold crest or front decorative red stripe copied to the inner face. LEFT PROFILE = near shield seen mostly edge-on, held in front of near left forearm; it must not become another chest/wing.
- Exactly TWO big rectangular shoulder/back cannons, parallel to body forward direction above shoulders, same round gold elevation pivots and navy/ivory casing. FRONT shows two BLACK RECTANGULAR MUZZLES. REAR shows TWO CLOSED ARMORED BREECHES/connection housings, NOT forward muzzle holes. PROFILE tubes point horizontally toward screen-left; near and far guns may occlude, do not invent extra cannons.
- ONE bilateral multilayer wing fan on rear wing spars, retaining the approved navy/ivory/gold surfaces and long red-tipped upper blades plus shorter lower fins. Keep the SAME physical blade inventory, blade lengths, hinge roots and layering across views; foreshortening/occlusion may hide a blade but never add a new wing on the chest. The FRONT wings project to either side behind shoulders; REAR shows the same fan roots, cross-support and backs of the SAME blades. PROFILE fans are compressed edge-on behind the back.
- Paired wing-root cylindrical booster clusters and exactly TWO long lower-back booster nacelles, one at each side, slanting down/out to lower-calf height, blue/ivory/gold shell and red end vent per approved source. Not extra legs, shields or rifles.
- Exactly FOUR leg missile pods: one on OUTER each thigh and one on OUTER each calf. Each has an ivory-edged dark face with exactly TWO circular launch apertures matching approved whole-body Input 1. Do NOT take a third aperture from any older parts sheet. Front-facing apertures stay on the pod FRONT; rear shows closed rear armor and attachment rails. Rear has two pods on each side of the body, not extra copies on inner legs.
Backpack: coherent central navy load-bearing spine between the two cannon trunnions, separate wing struts and lower booster mounts; show how approved equipment connects without inventing another backpack, third gun or fifth pod. Core body remains visible between gear.
Style: same clean cel robot design, controlled line hierarchy, broad armor planes and hard two-tone shadows. Faint horizontal registration lines only. No text, labels, numbers, arrows, title bars, extra figures or redesign.
